# Function Objective: Print one line of the grade report
# Input parameters : str_student_name (string) student name, gpax (float) GPAX value
# Function description: Shorten a long name to the maximum length, then print the name and the GPAX
# Return Value : void
# Created By : Programmer A
# Create Date: 2026-09-28
# Revised By:
# Revised Date:
def Print_Report(str_student_name, gpax):
    MAX_NAME_LENGTH = 30
    bln_Is_Name_Long = len(str_student_name) > MAX_NAME_LENGTH
    # check whether the name must be shortened
    if bln_Is_Name_Long:
        print(str_student_name[:MAX_NAME_LENGTH], gpax)
    # else the name fits on one line
    else:
        print(str_student_name, gpax)
